lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase TbZnTe3 (space group I-4m2, No. 119) has a 20-atom unit cell containing four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Tb centers surrounded by eight Te neighbors, while Te sites display four- and six-coordinate environments. Zn centers adopt a tetrahedral motif with four Te neighbors, with distances ranging from 2.58 to 2.83 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Zn tetrahedra and corner-sharing between Tb and Zn polyhedra.
